internalDescription.text:
Can be used by project specifics to tag mapping models and e.g. treat them specifically in project code. Does not directly influence the general A12 mapping behavior itself.

####

A name or id that uniquely identifies this source.

At modeling time, in the partially-generated precomputation dm, the source name will determine the root group name inside which the source dm is included.

At runtime, the calling code is expected to label the given source documents/IData with the corresponding name, in order to associate it with the appropriate source (in case there is more than one source).

May or may not be equal to the source's dmId, but it is recommended to not include the specific version of the source DM into the source name, so that both precomputation fragments and the calling code at runtime remain compatible across versions.

####
